nodes.label: Gate 2929582856: App Sunset Forced Update
nodes.rationale: This gate can display a full-screen overlay that blocks application use; the document says it requires a patch. It is absent from the regular 30-gate delivery list and may be triggered by deferred loading or specific conditions.

nodes.label: patch-sunset.js
nodes.rationale: Short-circuits the App Sunset guard by replacing Cs(i) with false so the forced-update overlay cannot block use.
